description: This Java class 'SerializedObject' represents a serialized object stored in the database within the OpenMRS system. It includes metadata like type, subtype, serialization class, and the serialized data itself, and is managed via JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: SerializedObject
classes.description: Entity class representing a serialized object stored in the database, extending OpenMRS metadata base class, with fields for type, subtype, serialization class, and serialized data.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the serialized object, including its subtype and name.
